capabilities.name: 2D drafting
capabilities.description: Interactive drawing, editing, selection and snapping for 2D entities.
evidence: apps/cadcraft reports 2,212 test attributes; they were not executed here
capabilities.notes: Code exists and is shipped by CADCraft. Not verified in this workspace because the engine and UI were not built on this 7.4 GB host.

capabilities.name: 2D constraints
capabilities.description: Geometric constraint solving for drafting.
capabilities.notes: No test result recorded; solving performance is not benchmarked.

capabilities.name: 2D geometry
capabilities.description: Vectors, lines, arcs, circles, splines, intersections and bounds.
capabilities.notes: Verified by execution on this host. Tolerance is a single global EPS = 1e-9, not the contract Tolerance type.

capabilities.name: DXF import/export
capabilities.description: Read DXF R12-2018 and write R2000.
capabilities.notes: Round-trip fidelity is not measured here; units are carried as INSUNITS rather than typed.

capabilities.name: DWG import
capabilities.description: Read DWG through the acadrust parser.
capabilities.notes: Depends on MPL-2.0 acadrust used unmodified. No DWG corpus exists to judge compatibility.

capabilities.name: 2D document model
capabilities.description: Entity store with stable handles and cheap copy-on-write undo snapshots.
capabilities.notes: Undo cost is designed for but never measured.

capabilities.name: Parametric 3D document
capabilities.description: Feature timeline with incremental recomputation and stable topological references.
capabilities.notes: SolidCraft advertises its broad feature timeline with stable face lineage; locally verified persistence is separately recorded as cap.document.project-persistence and supports rectangle plus extrude only.

capabilities.name: 3D sketch and constraints
capabilities.description: Sketches consumed by parametric features, with a constraint solver.
capabilities.notes: Solver performance is not benchmarked.

capabilities.name: Extrude
capabilities.description: Sweep a validated planar profile into a solid.
capabilities.notes: Analytic volume asserted, not self-consistency.

capabilities.name: Boolean union
capabilities.description: Union two solids, counting the shared volume once.
capabilities.notes: 100 of 100 benchmark unions needed the coplanar retry nudge.

capabilities.name: Boolean intersection
capabilities.description: Intersection of two solids.
capabilities.notes: Verified on a 2x2x10 mm overlap (40 mm3).

capabilities.name: Boolean difference
capabilities.description: Subtract one solid from another.
capabilities.notes: The published truck path returns a solid with the wrong volume (1053.3 mm3 vs 840 analytic), so the experimental adapter refuses it. SolidCraft's production kernel has its own guarded implementation, but its test suite was not run here.

capabilities.name: Fillet and chamfer
capabilities.description: Round or bevel edges.
capabilities.notes: Present in SolidCraft's kernel (read from source); not exercised in this workspace because the kernel test suite was not run.

capabilities.name: Tessellation
capabilities.description: Convert a solid into a validated, closed triangle mesh.
capabilities.notes: Verified for planar boxes only. Curved-surface tessellation was not measured. Per-face vertices are welded and the winding is made consistent outward on the way out: before that repair a box cap was wound inward and the mesh reported 8 open edges. The studio also tessellates circle-derived polygons; those are still planar profiles, so no curved-surface claim is added.

capabilities.name: STEP import/export
capabilities.description: Read and write STEP through truck-stepio.
capabilities.notes: No round-trip measurement recorded.

capabilities.name: Mesh import/export
capabilities.description: STL, OBJ, 3MF and glTF import/export.
capabilities.notes: No import budgets (file size, zip entries, uncompressed size) are implemented yet.

capabilities.name: MCP server
capabilities.description: Expose CAD commands to agents over the Model Context Protocol.
capabilities.notes: Transport internals were not audited. A loopback control port is reachable by any local process.

capabilities.name: 3D viewport rendering
capabilities.description: Render solids with wgpu and pick entities.
capabilities.notes: No frame-time or picking measurement is claimed: the only GPU on this host is integrated UHD.

capabilities.name: Versioned document header
capabilities.description: A schema-versioned document header with tested migrations v0 to v2 and an explicit refusal of newer schemas.
capabilities.notes: The parametric project layer writes this header as part of `.zcad`; the project payload has an independent schema.

capabilities.name: Workspace change detection
capabilities.description: Observe repositories, detect changed files and commits, generate idempotent tasks and render an evidence report.
capabilities.notes: Verified by 25 integration tests on this host, including a real git repository fixture.

capabilities.name: SaaS billing
capabilities.description: Subscription entitlements and a billing provider integration.
capabilities.notes: Not implemented. Pricing tiers are a product requirement, not working software.

capabilities.name: WebAssembly build
capabilities.description: Run the geometry stack in a browser.
capabilities.notes: wasm32-unknown-unknown and wasm-pack are not installed on this host; no WASM build has been performed.

capabilities.name: Realtime collaboration
capabilities.description: Multi-user editing with conflict resolution.
capabilities.notes: Not implemented. The current native project is single-user and feature-limited; semantic change merging and conflict recovery remain prerequisites.

capabilities.name: Binary STL export
capabilities.description: Write a validated triangle mesh as a binary STL file.
evidence: an independent Python parser read the written file: 12 triangles, volume 500.0000 mm3, 0 open edges
capabilities.notes: Written by cad-io; the CLI and studio are thin callers. STL has no unit field, so a document header must accompany it when units matter.

capabilities.name: Agent contract
capabilities.description: A versioned, self-describing declaration of what an agent is, what it accepts, what it produces and what it may do.
capabilities.notes: The contract version is a single integer. A contract that declares a different version is refused before it is stored, not half-interpreted.

capabilities.name: Agent runtime
capabilities.description: Registration, lifecycle enforcement, capability grants, budget enforcement and schema checking around agent calls.
capabilities.notes: An agent reaches ready only with a passing contract-test report and an owner decision covering every owner-gated permission it declares.

capabilities.name: Geometry operations agent
capabilities.description: Extrude, boolean, tessellate and measure solids through the shared kernel contract, inside the agent runtime.
capabilities.notes: Boolean difference is refused because the underlying adapter does not advertise it; the agent reports that rather than returning a wrong solid.

capabilities.name: Local parametric project persistence
capabilities.description: Create, validate, save, reopen, edit, recompute and export a parameterized project with rectangle, circle or regular-polygon sketches, an extrude, and stable entity IDs.
capabilities.notes: Schema 2 stores an explicit profile and migrates schema 1 on load. Saves sync a sibling temporary file before atomic rename; load validates live state and up to 64 history snapshots and rejects files over 64 MiB. Undo/redo survives separate CLI invocations and studio requests.

capabilities.name: Local entitlement policy
capabilities.description: Evaluate local/cloud feature tier inclusion, quotas, overage behavior and idempotent payment lifecycle events.
capabilities.notes: Policy logic only. No billing provider or live subscription service exists; prices are hypotheses and tax is not modeled as revenue.

capabilities.name: Local-first CAD studio
capabilities.description: Open a project, edit named parameters and the sketch profile, rebuild geometry, undo/redo, inspect faces, save atomically and export STL in a desktop browser session served from 127.0.0.1.
evidence: browser exercise: parameter 40 -> 20 rebuilt 6,000 mm3; circle and octagon rebuilds matched analytic volumes; save wrote schema 2; face pick returned X/Y/Z and normal
capabilities.notes: No accounts, cloud, collaboration or telemetry. The listener is loopback-only and every POST requires a same-origin Origin. It is one project per process, not a multi-user service.

capabilities.name: 3D viewport and face picking
capabilities.description: WebGL1 orbit/pan/zoom/fit viewport with shaded mesh, wireframe, grid, axes, sketch outline, and ray-triangle face picking.
evidence: browser exercise: WebGL context ready; 92-triangle circle mesh uploaded; clicking the viewport returned X -3.39, Y -3.65, Z 7.85 mm and normal (-0.609, -0.793, 0)
browser exercise: parameter and profile changes rebuilt and reframed the model without console or network errors
capabilities.notes: Exercised in Chromium through the harness. There is no pixel-level visual regression suite, and no performance claim for large meshes.

capabilities.name: Command palette
capabilities.description: Searchable, keyboard-driven palette over real document, view, profile, parameter and help commands.
evidence: browser exercise: Ctrl+K listed 19 connected commands; running “Profile: circle” changed the project profile and rebuilt 92 triangles
capabilities.notes: Every entry invokes the same API or UI function as its button; there are no placeholder commands.
